t: 1-component patio jointing mortar. Pre-mixed and ready to use, ideal for DIY use. Long-lasting and resistant to weather, water, frost and de-icing salts. Suitable for coated and sensitive stone surfaces, ceramic slabs, almost all natural stones, natural and concrete stone slabs and clinker stone surfaces. Also for use on patios, footpaths and surfaces which have occasional light vehicle loads. Firm to walk on and no weed growth. Brush applied with no special equipment required. Non-staining when the surface is permanently wet during application. Vacuum packed.
